@graph.name: Pnchy
@graph.description: Pnchy builds QR payment and loyalty tools for farmers market vendors, pop-ups and small shops in North America.

acceptedAnswer.text: Pnchy is a QR payment and loyalty tool for farmers market vendors, pop-ups and small shops. Customers scan your QR code, enter the short code you create for the sale, and pay on a web page with no app to download. Every purchase earns Pnches toward a reward you set, so first-time buyers turn into regulars. Pnchy is currently accepting founding vendors across North America.

mainEntity.name: How does a customer pay at my stall?

acceptedAnswer.text: You create a charge in the Pnchy business app and get a 4-character code. The customer scans your stall's QR code, enters that code, and pays by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or bank transfer (ACH) on a web page. The amount comes from your charge, so the customer cannot type a different one. A customer can also choose to pay cash, and you confirm it in the app.

mainEntity.name: Do my customers need to download an app?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Paying and earning Pnches both happen on a web page after a QR scan. Vendors use the Pnchy business app on iOS and Android to create charges, watch payments come in live, and get an alert when a payment or cash request arrives.

mainEntity.name: Can I take in-person card payments without a card reader?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Founding vendors can use Tap to Pay in the Pnchy business app to take in-person card payments by tapping a customer's card or phone on your own phone, so no separate card reader is needed. The sale still earns the customer Pnches.

mainEntity.name: What does Pnchy cost for vendors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Founding vendors pay no Pnchy fee. Card and bank payments still carry the processing cost charged by Stripe, our payment processor. Pnchy adds no markup on top: the amount deducted is an estimate of Stripe's processing cost. Cash payments carry no processing cost.

Pro is an optional subscription for vendors, $3.99 a month or $35.99 a year at US prices, billed through the App Store or Google Play. It adds branded receipt emails with your logo and colors, sending receipts and campaigns from your own email domain once it is verified, and higher email campaign limits than the free plan. The free plan stays fully functional for taking payments and loyalty.
Founding vendors are the first farmers market and pop-up vendors to use Pnchy. We are accepting them now across North America. Apply on our early access page and we will follow up with next steps.

mainEntity.name: How does loyalty work for my customers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each purchase earns a customer Pnches at your shop. You choose the reward and how many Pnches it takes. When a customer reaches it, they request the reward with a short code and you confirm it in the app. You can also switch on a welcome discount for first-time customers and choose the percentage.

mainEntity.name: How does Pnchy help me bring customers back?

acceptedAnswer.text: Customers can tick a box at checkout to hear from you. They confirm by email first, and only then can you send them email campaigns about sales and events. You see anonymous labels such as Customer #12, never customer email addresses. Your dashboard also shows sales over time, average spend and peak hours, so you know which market days work.

mainEntity.name: Does Pnchy handle tips, sales tax and cash?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can turn on optional tips for the pay page. If you turn on sales tax, it is calculated with Stripe Tax and added to the sale, and you stay responsible for filing and paying it. Cash sales are recorded in the app too, and the app shows the change to give back.

mainEntity.name: How is Pnchy different from Square, Shopify POS or Toast?

acceptedAnswer.text: Square, Shopify POS and Toast are full point-of-sale systems with registers, inventory and, in many plans, hardware and monthly fees. Pnchy is a lighter layer built for a stall: a QR code and a web page for payment with loyalty included, no card reader needed, and no Pnchy fee for founding vendors. It does not replace inventory or register features.
